_README: Expected values read off the documents by a human, not produced by the
parsers they check. Every figure below was confirmed against the filing's
own table or sentence before being written here.
A failing canary means the source changed shape or the parser broke. The
filing itself is immutable and cannot have changed, so NEVER edit an
expected value to make the check pass. Open the document first.
Each canary is chosen for a different SHAPE, not a different company:
table-form against prose-form, third-party bid against issuer self-tender,
a blank forecast against a filled one. A canary that repeats another's
shape costs a download and proves nothing new.

canaries.name: tender offer, third-party bid, table form
canaries.note: Luxshare for Seed. Price and size are in text-block tables; the denominator sits in a prose footnote and is not the tagged total.

canaries.name: tender offer result, issuer self-tender, column table
canaries.note: Itochu buying its own shares. The result table is column-oriented, unlike the row-oriented third-party form.

canaries.name: target board opinion
canaries.note: The element name for the opinion moved between taxonomy years; this canary is the reason the parser falls back to the Japanese heading.

canaries.name: tender offer amendment links to its parent
canaries.note: Amendment of S100YZ5A. Checks that an amended filing still resolves its parent and restates terms.

canaries.name: major shareholder change, prose form
canaries.note: Amaze. No table at all: holder, votes and percentage are numbered sentences.

canaries.name: parent change, prose identity card
canaries.note: Ryosan. The counterparty card is numbered prose, and the section heading lists every label word in one breath, which is what an over-loose pattern reads as the company name.

expect.list|parties|0|name: リョーサン菱洋ホールディングス株式会社

canaries.name: share exchange, table identity card
canaries.note: Shizuoka Financial Group. Counterparty card is a two-column table; capital keeps the unit the filing printed.

canaries.name: third-party allotment, single allottee
canaries.note: Right-on. Proceeds identity holds exactly: 650,000,010 less 8,000,000 of costs is 642,000,010.

canaries.name: third-party allotment, several allottees
canaries.note: Abalance. Issue price and payment per share differ here, which is why no gate compares them.

canaries.name: semiannual balance sheet
canaries.note: Seed's half year. Assets equal liabilities plus net assets to the yen, and the prior full-year comparative sits in a different context from the interim one.

canaries.name: earnings release with a blank forward forecast
canaries.note: Nihon Ski Resort. THE canary for the self-closing trap: several forecast fields here are written xsi:nil and must stay absent. Before the fix the blank next-year sales came out as 15.8 yen, which was the +15.8% change figure two rows below.
